newsitem.title: GERMANY: German watchdog looking into Daimler disclosure.
newsitem.headline: German watchdog looking into Daimler disclosure.

text.p: German securities watchdog BAWe is looking into Daimler-Benz AG's financial disclosure policies after a Daimler board member provided reporters with approximate figures for the firms 1996 results, BAWe spokesman Juergen Oberfrank told Reuters on Wednesay.
Oberfrank said it was too early, however, to say if the Daimler executive had broken any rules on disclosure which are meant to ensure a fair dissemination of financial results here.
At issue were remarks made by Daimler management board member Eckard Cordes to reporters attending a dinner at the Geneva car show.
Cordes said Daimler-Benz's group 1996 net profit would be more than two billion marks and sales around 107 billion marks. Daimler reported a 5.7 billion mark loss in 1995.
A Daimler spokesman on Tuesday would not confirm the figures, telling Reuters that official results will not be made public until the company holds its annual press conference next month.
